limits.comment: This model can only have the Core role if your Leader is a Tyranid Warrior or a Tyranid Shrike.
If your Leader is a Flying Tyranid, this model may have the Core role.
This model can only have the Core role if your Leader is a Genestealer or a Broodlord.
You cannot have more than 1 of this model in your warband

wargear.name: Accelerated Healing
wargear.notes: This model has the Regeneration (2+) ability. If the value rolled for this ability is 6+, they regain 2 life instead of 1.

wargear.name: Acid Blood
wargear.notes: Each time an enemy model or unit makes a melee attack with this model as a target, once the attack has been resolved, roll a number of D8s equal to the life this model lost as a result of that attack. For each 6+ rolled, the attacking model or unit suffers one AP 1 hit.

wargear.name: Adrenal Glands
wargear.notes: This model adds 2″ to their advancing Mv value.

wargear.name: Brainleech Worms
wargear.notes: When this model attacks with a Living Ammo weapon, place a Brainleech marker next to any model that loses life as a result of the attack. In the Take Damage step of the Resolution Phase, each model with any Brainleech markers next to them must roll a number of D8s equal to their Ld value. For each 1 rolled, that model suffers an injury. Then remove that model's Brainleech marker.

wargear.name: Cerebryogenesis
wargear.notes: This model has the Psyker (Powers of the Hive Mind) ability.

wargear.name: Enhanced Senses
wargear.notes: This model reduces any hit roll penalty they incur for firing at long range by 1 (to a minimum of 0).

wargear.name: Evolved Ammunition
wargear.notes:
When you create your warband, choose one of the following abilities. For the duration of the game, every model in your warband with evolved ammunition has this ability.
Corrosive Grubs: Any Living Ammo weapon this model is armed with adds 1 to its AP value.
Swollen Gestation Sacs: Any Living Ammo weapon this model is armed with (excluding thorax swarms) has the Rapid Fire type. Its rapid fire A value is 1 more than its ordinary A value. If this model is armed with a thorax swarm, it instead changes its A value to 2.
Violent Emesis: When this model attacks with a Living Ammo weapon, if the target is within 8″, this model incurs a critical hit bonus of 1 for that attack.

wargear.name: Flesh Hooks
wargear.notes: At the beginning of each Close Quarters Phase, you may choose one enemy model within 1″ of this model and attempt to ensnare them with this model's flesh hooks. Roll a D8: if the result is less than the target model's CS value, they are ensnared - they fight last this phase.

wargear.name: Hardened Carapace
wargear.notes: This model improves their armour save by 1.

wargear.name: Hyper-adaptive biology
wargear.notes: While this model has lost any life, they have the Ignore Damage (7+) ability. While their remaining life is half their total Lf value or less, they have the Ignore Damage (6+) ability instead; or while they are seriously injured, they have the Ignore Damage (5+) ability.

wargear.name: Lurking Predator
wargear.notes: This model has the Ambush ability.

wargear.name: Monstrous Musculature
wargear.notes: This model incurs a critical hit bonus of 1 for all of their melee attacks. This model's melee weapons (excluding lash whips and thorax swarms) add 1 to their critical Dm value.

wargear.name: Precognitive Sensoria
wargear.notes: This model fights first in the Close Quarters Phase.

wargear.name: Psionic Reservoir
wargear.notes: When this model generates their warp charges, if the number of charges they generate (before overcharging) is 1 or less, they generate 1 additional charge.

wargear.name: Razor Chitin
wargear.notes: Add 1 to the ordinary AP value of this model's melee weapons (excluding a lash whip, acid maw or thorax swarm).

wargear.name: Synaptic Resonance
wargear.notes:
If a friendly Hive Fleets model has a worse BS or CS value than this model's, they improve that value by 1 while they are within 9″ of this model.

If this model is a Zoanthrope, the ability above is ignored; instead, friendly Hive Fleets models have a 7+ invulnerable save while they are within 9″ of this model.

wargear.name: Toxin Sacs
wargear.notes: Any melee weapon (excluding a lash whip, acid maw or thorax swarm) and any spinefist or spike rifle this model is armed with has the Poison (6+) type.

weapons.name: Acid Maw
weapons.notes: The bearer can attack with this weapon as an additional secondary weapon.

weapons.name: Barbed strangler
weapons.notes: Blast (4). Successful hits allocated to the initial model nominated as the target for the attack are always critical hits. If the initial model is part of a unit, the player controlling the unit chooses which model in the unit suffers the critical hits (the chosen model must have been allocated at least one successful hit).

weapons.name: Lash Whip
weapons.notes: The bearer can use the Shield ability during the Close Quarters Phase. This weapon can only be used as a secondary weapon, but uses its normal A value, instead of being reduced to an A value of 1.

weapons.name: Scything Talon
weapons.notes: Paired. The bearer may use any number of scything talons they are armed with as additional secondary weapons. These additional secondary weapons can only ever have an A value 1, regardless of any other rules.

weapons.name: Spinefist
weapons.notes: Pistol, Paired. This weapon cannot target models that are more than 12″ away.

weapons.name: Spinemaws
weapons.notes: For every full 2 life the bearer has lost, reduce this weapon's A value by 1.

weapons.name: Thorax Swarm
weapons.notes: Engulf (4), Living Ammo. The bearer can attack with this weapon as an additional secondary weapon. When this weapon is a secondary weapon, it uses its normal A value, instead of being reduced to an A value of 1.

weapons.name: Venom Cannon
weapons.notes: Poison (7+), Rapid Fire. When attacking with this weapon, if the bearer does not move in the same phase, they may use this weapon's rapid fire A value for the attack even if the target is more than 12″ away from them.
